messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts detected in eu-west1 edge gateway starting ~08:12 UTC. P95 latency spike and 502/504 surge. Auto-escalate to #incidents and page oncall.

alice_oncall: ack. I'm oncall. paging SRE and runtime. tagging: @ben_runtime @dinesh_infra @carol_prod :rotating_light:

ben_runtime: looking at logs now — getting a lot of 502s from edge -> inference-gateway (router). stack traces show upstream connection resets and backlog at the mlworkers pool. request queue depth jumped from ~10 -> 450 in 5m.

dinesh_infra: checking infra metrics — kvcache redis cluster in eu-west1 reporting 99th latency 1.2s, and memory pressure with evictions. we had a rolling kvmem GC at 08:05 but it shouldn't coincide like this.

carol_prod: customer impact? any enterprise customers on eu-west1 dedicated pools? need list for comms.

ben_runtime: short answer: yes — three dedicated pools serving prod for enterprise accounts (acme, hyperfin, learnly). telemetry shows ~8% of generate calls from acme failed with 5xx 08:12-08:22. embedding calls less affected.

alice_oncall: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) shift edge traffic away from eu-west1 to eu-west2 (gradual), 2) increase inference-gateway pool in eu-west1 if capacity allows, 3) enable route fallback to quantized model variant to reduce memory/use. which is fastest?

ben_runtime: fastest is to reroute at the edge LB by changing weights. command (runbook):

```
# temporary: move 50% traffic from eu-west1 -> eu-west2
rbctl traffic-weight --from eu-west1 --to eu-west2 --weight 50
```

Also can flip model policy to use smaller-quant variant for high-latency paths:

```
runtimectl set-model-variant --service generate --variant small-quant --selector region=eu-west1 --grace-period 30s
```

dinesh_infra: autoscaler for the gateway pools isn't scaling — looks like the instance group hit a soft quota in eu-west1 (vCPU). I'm requesting quota bump but until then we should drain traffic.

alice_oncall: ben, please start reroute 50% now and monitor 5xx rate. carol, pull impacted customers and prepare comm draft. dinesh, continue quota and check whether we can spin managed nodes in eu-west2 for extra capacity.

ben_runtime: executing reroute now.

incident-bot: ACTION LOG: rbctl traffic-weight executed by ben_runtime at 08:18:34 UTC. new weights applied.

ben_runtime: early telemetry: 5xx rate in eu-west1 dropped from 11.8% -> 5.4% at 08:22. total p95 latency across regions decreased ~30ms. but we're still seeing sporadic 502s from edge-proxy -> router.

carol_prod: comms draft in #incidents-digest. quick note: "We are currently mitigating a regional edge issue impacting a subset of generate requests for customers in the EU region. Our engineers have rerouted traffic and are monitoring. We will follow up with impact and timeline." thoughts?

alice_oncall: that's fine. add impacted customer list and ETA for next update: 30 mins.

ben_runtime: additional mitigation: toggled model variant fallback for heavy routes (applied to acme and hyperfin). noticed memory pressure on mlworkers dropped after fallback. ran:

```
# fallback mapping
modelmap apply --service generate --customer acme,hyperfin --fallback small-quant
```

pagerduty-bot: Event: oncall handoff scheduled at 08:45 UTC -> night-sre.

dinesh_infra: quota request approved for temporary vCPU burst in eu-west1, ETA ~18 minutes to provision. we can scale pool once nodes up.

ben_runtime: after fallback + reroute we see 5xx ~2.1% now in eu-west1, but edge-proxy still emits occasional conn reset patterns every ~3-5 minutes. opening a deeper trace with tcpdump on an edge node.

alice_oncall: please paste tcpdump snippet if you see reproducible pattern. also start a canary traffic test to ensure correctness of eu-west2 route.

ben_runtime: tcpdump snippet (sanitized):

```
08:20:01.123456 IP edge1 -> router1: SYN
08:20:01.123789 IP router1 -> edge1: RST
08:20:01.124000 IP edge1 -> router1: SYN
08:20:01.124200 IP router1 -> edge1: SYN,ACK
```

Signals point to intermittent conn resets between edge and router, possibly due to kernel conntrack exhaustion after high backlog and then GC.

dinesh_infra: confirmed conntrack high water marks at 08:15 — kernel dropped new sockets. ramped conntrack max and retested; need kernel param persist. patching sysctl on edge pool nodes.

alice_oncall: great. after conntrack bump + reroute -> eu-west2 + model fallback we should stabilize. set next update in 20m. assign postmortem owners.

carol_prod: drafting customer-facing note: short, deets + mitigations + affected timeframe. will link to status.redwood.ai/incidents/1798799999 when we have full timeline.

ben_runtime: infra patch rolled (conntrack params) at 08:33:02 UTC. restarting affected edge proxies one-by-one to pick up sysctl.

incident-bot: METRIC: eu-west1 generate 5xx rate: 11.8% -> 5.4% -> 2.1% -> 0.7% between 08:12-08:40 UTC. false positives reduced.

alice_oncall: handoff to night-sre in 12m. leaving notes: reroute persisted at 50% to eu-west2; small-quant fallback applied to acme/hyperfin; conntrack sysctl patched; quota requested and provisioning in progress. if things look stable at 09:00 UTC we'll start a gradual traffic shift back.

dinesh_infra: quota nodes provisioned at 08:52; scaled gateway pool. starting gradual drain from eu-west2 back to eu-west1 at 09:04 per runbook.

ben_runtime: rolling back model fallback after capacity increased; monitoring. 5xx steady at 0.3% now.

carol_prod: sending customer follow-ups: short update sent to acme and hyperfin — they acknowledged.

alice_oncall: incident declared mitigated at 09:12 UTC. filing postmortem, owners: ben_runtime (runtime), dinesh_infra (infra), carol_prod (customer comms).

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVE: alert quieted and oncall notified.

alice_oncall: closing thread in 1h after postmortem draft. thanks all :raised_hands:

-- Conversation notes --
- Root cause (prelim): combination of conntrack exhaustion during brief kvcache GC spike leading to connection resets, plus vCPU quota preventing autoscaling -> backlog and 502/504s.
- Mitigations used: traffic weight shift, model-variant fallback, sysctl conntrack bump, temporary vCPU quota and scale up.
- Customer impact: subset of generate requests for 3 enterprise customers between 08:12-09:04 UTC, peak 11.8% 5xx.
- Followups: persist conntrack sysctl as a config, improve autoscaler quota alerts, add runbook step to auto-fallback to quantized variant under memory pressure, postmortem scheduled."
